about.text: The cheese of Tafi del Valle, Tucumán, is the oldest cheese of Argentine origin, created in the 18th century and traditionally attributed to Jesuit missionaries. Along with Goya cheese, Tafí del Valle cheese is one of the few typical Latin American food products with nearly three hundred years of history.
